description: List the packaging structures Drint draws as print-ready dielines (tuck end boxes, auto-lock bottoms, mailers, FEFCO cartons, paper bags, rigid boxes, drawers, pillow boxes, sleeves, pouches, cups, labels…), with each one's type id and default size in mm, and find standard die codes: about 180 FEFCO (corrugated, e.g. 0201, 0427) and ECMA (folding cartons, e.g. A20.20.03.01) codes. Optional query: a code or a few words ("0201", "reverse tuck", "crash lock", "hộp nắp gài", "bag"). Each comes with a link that starts a Drint design on that die.

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.

query.description: A few words, English or Vietnamese. Empty: all of them.

name: list_dielines
title: Find dieline structures
